notes.title: 📢 Citizens, attention! Our engineers have prepared Patch #2
notes.notes:
[p][b]Deserter: Prologue[/b] continues to evolve under your watchful feedback and our tireless effort. Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]Korean language localization. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved character voiceovers. Added a new voice for the elite soldier.	[/p][/*][*][p]New items can now be found in houses every day. [/p][/*][*][p]NPCs react faster when they spot the protagonist: they chase or attack more aggressively and coordinate better in groups. [/p][/*][*][p]NPCs now interact with windows: they can look and shoot through them, and even climb through to continue the chase.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the problem where difficulty levels may not have applied properly - so if you found the game too hard on Easy or vice versa, make sure to give it another go!
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Inventory UI improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now sell all useless junk at once when starting a trade. [/p][/*][*][p]Tool icons now display which objects they can be used to unlock. [/p][/*][*][p]When inspecting certain consumables, you’ll see which of John’s parameters they affect (hunger, fatigue, health).
[/p][/*][/list][p]Together we strengthen the cause - your feedback is the fuel of progress. Now is the perfect time to try [i]Deserter: Prologue[/i], share your thoughts, and maybe even leave a review.[/p]

notes.title: Decree on Technical Readiness for Steam Deck
notes.notes: [p]The Ministry of Progress proudly announces: [b]Steam Deck readiness achieved[/b]. Efficiency and stability are guaranteed for all comrades in the field.[/p][list][*][p]Controls are perfectly suited for comfortable play on [b]Steam Deck[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The interface is legible and well-adjusted for the device’s resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Stable performance: from 30 up to 60+ FPS across different graphics presets.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Ministry declares: Play with comfort, play wherever you want.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Attention, citizens - first updates are here!
notes.notes: [p]The Prologue continues matching in step with progress under the Party's vigilant eye. Thanks for all the feedback—here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]Added the ability to observe hostile NPC patrol routes (default key: [b]R[/b]).[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to rebind control keys.[/p][/*][*][p]After unlocking a furniture, the character now automatically searches its contents.[/p][/*][*][p]New option in settings to enable/disable auto-vaulting over fences and climbing obstacles.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly adjusted the tilt angle and zoom of the top-down camera, now closer in style to [i]Gone Rogue[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Improved NPC behavior: they now react better to the player within their [b]Sixth Sense[/b] radius or when hiding inside cover.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed animation bugs for NPCs and the player.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now select lockpicking tools using the mouse wheel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed in-game stutters (micro-freezes).[/p][/*][*][p]Many minor bug fixes, location refinements, and improvements to UI readability.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re continuing to refine the experience—thank you for playing and sharing your thoughts! Now is the perfect time to try Deserter: Prologue, share your thoughts, and maybe even leave a review—your voice strengthens the cause and helps us tremendously.[/p]

notes.title: Deserter: Prologue is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[p]The Party demands obedience. The war devours the souls. John Holden makes his choice: desertion.
[/p][p]

notes.title: First Step Toward Escape
notes.notes: [p]We’re thrilled to announce that the [b]Deserter: Prologue[/b] page is now live—and the release is just around the corner, coming mid-August![/p][p][b]Prologue[/b] is a standalone chapter that precedes the main story of [b]Deserter[/b]. We’ve created it to give you early access to the new gameplay systems, a glimpse into the world’s evolving atmosphere, and a taste of what’s to come after [b]Gone Rogue[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692050/5474c2aa535721f88625c70d2de0f84b4b1572ce.png"][/img][/p][p]If you’re into games like [i]Thief[/i], [i]Dishonored[/i], [i]Shadow Tactics[/i], or [i]Commandos[/i], this might just be what you’ve been looking for.[/p][p]If you enjoy slow-burn stealth, difficult choices, and grim, atmospheric locations—wishlist the game and stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3248910/Deserter/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
